# Indra’s jewel net

<a id="indra-selected-telling"></a>
## #0 — A jewel is chosen within the net

The net belongs to Indra’s celestial image-world. Its development here belongs to Chinese Huayan: the contemplation transmitted in the *Huayan wujiao zhiguan*, conventionally attributed to Dushun, whose authorship remains disputed. Thomas Cleary’s English excerpt in *Dharma Rain* (2000), pages 58–60, is the selected translation; its earlier container is *Entry into the Inconceivable* (1983), pages 66–68. The Chinese doctrinal work and its English transmissions have these different temporal locations. Indra’s celestial setting gives the teaching its image-world. The [Dushun-attributed transmission](../../../../episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/dushun/dushun-cleary-2000-jewel-net-indra/dushun-cleary-2000-jewel-net-indra.md) preserves their attribution and edition limits.

The telling begins with knowledge. If phenomena arise through conditions, how can they be known? The answer places knowing within their relation. The contemplating eye encounters a field in which phenomena enter one another; it cannot secure an independent beginning outside that field and then look down upon the result. The jewel net gives this encounter a visible body.

The jewels are clear. In every jewel the others appear, and what appears includes their reflections of one another. Choose a jewel in the southwest. The choice gives attention an exact place to begin. All the other jewels are reflected there together. Each of those jewels also reflects the whole, including the selected jewel. Following a reflection therefore brings the point of departure back into view within the very field it discloses. The net opens again inside its own appearance.

Nothing in the operation reserves this capacity for the southwest jewel. Begin elsewhere and the same relation holds. Every jewel supplies a particular entrance; none has to travel to a privileged centre before the others can become present. The text makes the claim through simultaneous manifestation and the absence of coming and going. The ordered sentences teach attention how to follow what the image presents together. Their sequence must not be converted into a physical account of signals taking successive journeys.

<a id="indra-recursive-entry"></a>
## #1 — Entering the others without leaving this one

Now the contemplation asks the reader to remain within the selected jewel. To enter all the jewels from here is to discover their presence in this one; in those jewels this one is present again. The movement reverses without losing its starting place. Reflections contain reflections which contain the first reflection, with no final image at which the relation becomes exhausted.

An interlocutor presses the difficulty. How can one enter all while remaining here? The reply makes remaining here the condition of entry. Leaving the jewel behind would abandon the very relation through which the others are disclosed. Another question follows: if the many are present within this one, why speak of a net made from many jewels at all? The answer treats the one in its comprehensive aspect. Its formation includes the many; remove that constitutive participation and this whole net has not been preserved. The movement repeatedly brings the apparent opposition between one jewel and many jewels back to how each is present through the others.

The final test gives the contemplation a mark. Put an ink dot upon the southwest jewel. The dot appears throughout the reflected field. Its many appearances do not require someone to have gone around physically marking every jewel. Begin with another jewel and the relation can be followed from there as well. The mark makes a return inspectable: something done at this definite place becomes present through the others, and the others disclose this place in turn.

Indra supplies the celestial name; the jewels, their clarity, their reflected images, the selected direction, the ink mark, the questioner and the answering contemplative voice each have work to do. This is the whole action of a teaching image. Its development occurs as each question changes what the initial sight of a shining net can mean.

The expanded sequence occurs in the Chinese text, T45 no. 1867, 513a20–513c16: selected jewel, reciprocal entry, questions, ink-dot test and closing qualification. The [CBETA primary-text transcription](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cbeta-org/xml-p5/master/T/T45/T45n1867.xml) makes that whole contemplative movement available. This telling is a prose paraphrase; Cleary’s selected printed English wording remains uncollated.

<a id="indra-simile-and-distinctness"></a>
## #2 — The image teaches where its own likeness ends

The teaching does not end with the ink dot. It turns upon its simile. Jewels have images which enter one another while their material substances remain separate; the phenomena for which the image is being used interpenetrate more completely. The resemblance is therefore partial. This restriction belongs to the source’s own movement, immediately after its most forceful demonstration. It prevents the observer from taking the optical apparatus as a complete account of the reality contemplated.

The closing verses direct the teaching toward Vairocana’s activity for beings. Formless reality manifests forms; the immeasurable is present through particular appearances. The contemplative return has a purpose beyond admiration of an ingenious arrangement. The image is offered to open understanding, and its own inadequacy becomes part of that offering. Its jewel substances do not establish an ontology of permanently isolated things. Equally, the source’s stronger claim about interpenetration needs to be understood within Huayan, rather than translated without remainder into another tradition’s account of identity.

[Van Norden and Jones](../../../../episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/van-norden/van-norden-jones-2024-huayan-sep/van-norden-jones-2024-huayan-sep.md) distinguish two contributions in their [fixed Fall 2024 Huayan account](https://plato.stanford.edu/archives/fall2024/entries/buddhism-huayan/). In §1.3 each thing depends upon the others for existence and identity. Their §3 account of Zhiyan’s Ten Mysteries retains distinction within mutual inclusion and determination. Dependence and retained distinction together explain why the jewel’s comprehensive appearance belongs to a plurality whose members remain definite.

Each jewel is definite enough to be selected, reflected and marked. Its definiteness participates in the field which appears through it. The inward depth of the reflection and the outward plurality of the net are both active. [Fusion](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C24-Fusion.md) would erase the differences through which this inclusion works. The comparison therefore holds each local entrance together with its constitutive participation, allowing Huayan’s stronger account of interpenetration its own doctrinal scope.

[Homological agreement and analogical proportion](../../../../episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD-homology-and-analogy.md) articulate the crossing. A definite local member discloses its constitutive relations, including their return through that member; this is the preserved operation. A different image can carry that operation in a specified respect while its objects remain different. Here the source makes the comparison more exact by naming the respect in which its own material likeness fails: reflected images enter one another while jewel substances remain separate. The stronger interpenetration belongs to the phenomena contemplated. [Whole and many](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A12-Mono-Poly-One-All-Whole-Many.md) can now retain constitutive participation, while [the two logics](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md) keep determination and gathering distinct. The Huayan passage can correct a comparison which treats its partial optical likeness as complete.

<a id="indra-native-relation"></a>
## #3 — The definite jewel carries its constituting field

The [two Ones](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) differentiate `0 = One`, Self-Identity, and `1 = All`, Self-Difference. [Their reciprocal offices](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C49-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) let the condition become manifest through a determination which depends upon it. One is not a privileged jewel standing outside the net; All includes the relations through which every local entrance becomes this one. The [Two Ones Matheme](../../../../matheme/ql/two-ones.md) gives their exact numerical and relational construction. The chosen jewel figures an already active relation becoming locally available. The [native core](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md) and [Definition of God](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3.md) develop the determining relation and the finite account’s answerability within it.

[Whole and many](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A12-Mono-Poly-One-All-Whole-Many.md) hold two aspects together. Under its inclusive aspect the whole contains real particulars; under its generative aspect it is their constituting relation. [Mono](../../../../matheme/mono-poly/mono.md) develops expression and return through `0/1` and `1/0` in different orientations. The jewel’s presence within others’ reflections gives that return an image: its local comprehensive appearance keeps the dependence through which it is a member of the net.

Three distinguishable operations now cross. [Constitutive exclusion](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A08-Apoha-Constitutive-Exclusion.md) makes a positive reference determinate through its relation to non-application. In [apoha](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C18-Apoha.md), nominally and verbally bound negations work together without cancelling into an isolated positive. Dependent arising concerns conditioned occurrence. Saṃkalpa builds a world through constructive intention. The Huayan net adds recursive mutual inclusion: choosing a definite jewel keeps its constituting field active. The crossing gathers these operations while each retains the object and relation it explains.

[Luminous appearing and reflexive articulation](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A05-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) sharpen the reflective crossing. Śaiva [Prakāśa–Vimarśa](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C13-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) carries self-apprehension, retention and free formation as inseparable powers. The jewel displays reflected contents; the reader’s contemplation apprehends and follows their relation. These are different offices. An inert optical picture performs display, while the Śaiva living-mirror account develops appearing which knows itself and generates its appearances. The comparison is exact through what each actually does: recursive mutual inclusion in the net, self-apprehending articulation in the Śaiva account, and a situated reader whose understanding changes through the teaching.

The [eight determinations](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) unfold `−/− → 0/1 → ?/! → −/+ → X/x → AM/IS → ∞/dx → 1/0`, under the parent `/ = −/−`. A determination emerges within relation; the selected point becomes question and response; its contrast remains held; the indefinite particular `x` participates without exhausting `X`. Address carries the relation into an encounter, and the local differential remains exact within inexhaustible articulation. The return reopens the source relation through the achieved appearance. The jewel teaching gives this traversal a body: choosing, questioning, following a definite contrast and encountering its limit change the reader’s relation to the initial appearance. `X/x`, `AM/IS` and `∞/dx` retain capacity/particular, personed and differential offices within that traversal.

Selection, recursive entry, qualification, authored determination, answerable use and return give the contemplation six successive turns. Their teaching movement and the eight determinations have different counts and offices. Native `2+2²=6` retains two terms and their four ordered pairings. [The two logics](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md), [Dia / Syn](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C50-Dia-Syn.md) and their [formal construction](../../../../matheme/dia-syn/README.md) make the local cut and gathering explicit: choosing a jewel makes attention determinate while keeping the field it distinguishes active. Polar relation, additive cancellation and directed appropriation remain different operations. Simultaneous reflection and the reader’s passage through the teaching likewise retain distinct temporal offices.

<a id="indra-account-and-consequence"></a>
## #4 — A reflection becomes answerable for its use

[Symbol, Account and Trust](../../../../episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD-symbol-account-and-trust.md) extend the image into four consequential operations. **Symbol answers to source:** this net discloses a source-specific relation, including the passage’s qualification of its own simile. [Image and valuation](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) keep even an impressive image alterable by what it represents. Its beauty can open attention; fidelity requires the relation through which the represented field can answer.

**Account does not replace source:** a description of what is reflected in one jewel is an articulation within the field. [Bimba–Pratibimba](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map.md) makes a corresponding reference office precise. A locally agreed reference can genuinely be Bimba for a judgment while remaining pratibimba relative to wider sources. In a local comparison, a judging agent occupies the functional knower office, its reference, memory and rule are means, and the alternatives compared are known. That agent and apparatus can in turn be means within a person’s containing inquiry. [Objective Internality](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md) holds these nested offices together. A wider source can correct the locally governing reference without making its prior authority unreal.

**Trust keeps the return route active:** using an account involves committed reliance upon a relation it cannot exhaust. [Trust and the formal limit](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) distinguish making dependence inspectable from undertaking its continuation. The jewel’s clarity shows the reflected relation; an actual commitment needs a bearer able to answer for its use and consequence. [Unity without possession](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md) keeps belonging consequential: the Other can be within Mono while exceeding my possession, and a human participant’s refusal remains capable of changing the encounter.

**Account re-enters source-field:** after an image guides action, its consequences become conditions of the next account. The ink-dot episode shows a local mark appearing throughout reflection. Conduct has another return: an encountered consequence can correct an answer, task, world-model, source, permission, evaluator or commission at the depth it warrants; a fitting condition can instead be retained with reasons. [Objective co-internality](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) and [reciprocal world-constitution](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C42-Objective-Co-Internality.md) make these crossings real through distinct local worlds. A later act inherits the corrected or justified condition, and the contributor can answer again. The reflected mark displays shared appearance; an institutional return requires this actual receiving and subsequent use.

The four operations hold together. The whole image gives the Symbol something definite to disclose; its textual limit corrects the Account; reliance carries that account into use; the effects of use make the image and its sources answerable in a later encounter. The achieved comparison has changed through that return: the likeness now preserves the relation and the exact respect in which its material cannot carry it.

The recursive net can now meet [Ares, Aphrodite, Hephaestus and Poseidon](../../hellenic/ares-aphrodite-hephaestus-poseidon/WHOLE.md#ares-guarantee-release). Their two nets perform different acts. Mutual implication makes a local entrance disclose its constituting field; capture organises bound participants as public evidence. Homer’s bonds culminate in Poseidon’s undertaking and release. This contemplation returns through the jewel’s reciprocal entry and the limit of its likeness. Keeping both complete actions allows the comparison to distinguish relation from containment.

<a id="indra-whole-return"></a>
## #5→0 — Return to the jewel whose brightness depends on the others

The technical and ethical return asks what a local office does with the conditions it receives. [Delegated power and labour](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return.md) make accepting a product answerable to the labour, costs and consequences borne elsewhere. [Commons](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C54-Commons-Non-Monopoly.md) keep practical powers available to their participants: set terms, refuse, revise, leave and reconnect. The jewel-net gives this inquiry a whole image. A definite participant’s capacity depends upon the relation it can help sustain; institutional answerability depends upon which affected participant can actually exercise each power.

[Planetary computation](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C62-Planetary-Computation.md) places that question within material and institutional conditions. Energy, labour, infrastructure and authority require actual inquiry into their production and distribution. [Compassion](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation.md) keeps these origins consequential. When sustaining people or environments bear excluded costs, the return reaches the terms of the commission able to answer for them. Loving sensitivity becomes practical through that route and the next act it changes or justifiably sustains.

[Constitutive exclusion](../../../../../section-rooms/01-differentiating-mind/movements/10-s0-p3-apoha.md) makes the selected member answerable through its contrast; Huayan inclusion makes its participation visible through reciprocal reflection. [The two-net encounter](../../../../../section-rooms/03-two-logics/movements/22-s2-p3-ares-aphrodite-harmonia.md) places that positive recursive whole beside capture and release. In [the sovereign commons](../../../../../section-rooms/07-instrument-returns/movements/46-s50-p3-4-2-mono-poly.md), locally authoritative centres share consequences while keeping the power to contest a reference field. The institutional architecture must enact those powers through actual permissions, receiving offices and answerable crossings.

[Integral zero](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md) keeps an achieved Symbol capable of another traversal. The [Neumann archetypal relation](../../../archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-return-bond) differentiates a local life and returns it through a bond which sustains further becoming. This jewel contemplation gives relation, differentiation and return its Chinese body: a selected jewel, the reflected others and a reader whose encounter changes through their participation.

Return now to the southwest jewel. The mark remains particular. Its reflection among the others makes the starting point present again, while the source’s final qualification prevents the viewer from possessing the teaching through a completed optical picture. What has changed is the encounter: the chosen jewel can no longer be understood apart from the relations its brightness makes visible. The return leaves a definite place from which to look again.

## Source standing

The Chinese contemplation, specialist Huayan interpretation and native comparative argument have distinct source offices. Cleary’s selected 2000 printed wording remains uncollated. The [complete contemplative continuation](../../../../episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/dushun/dushun-cleary-2000-jewel-net-indra/dushun-cleary-2000-jewel-net-indra.md#huayan-complete-contemplation) retains the primary XML and exact span through the ink-dot test, simile qualification and closing verses. Van Norden–Jones q001 is quotation-ready; q002 is a source-matched paraphrase. Their doctrinal scope supports dependence and distinction, while common historical descent, physical causes and realised institutional effects require their own evidence.
